173dd81de1e7a243.text: The Shelling of Mainila on 26 November 1939 was staged by the Soviet Union to justify the invasion of Finland. According to the Soviet report, four Soviet soldiers were killed in the incident. Finnish artillery could not reach the village of Mainila.
claims: The Shelling of Mainila on 26 November 1939 was staged by the Soviet Union to justify the invasion of Finland.
According to the Soviet report, four Soviet soldiers were killed in the incident.
Finnish artillery could not reach the village of Mainila.
